package parsers

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

func parseStringParam(r *http.Request, name string, validate *validator.Validate, rule string) (*string, error) {
	value := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get(name))
	if value == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if validate != nil && rule != "" {
		if err := validate.Var(value, rule); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return &value, nil
}

func parseIntParam(r *http.Request, name string, validate *validator.Validate, rule string) (*int, error) {
	raw := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get(name))
	if raw == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s", name)
	}
	if validate != nil && rule != "" {
		if err := validate.Var(value, rule); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return &value, nil
}

func parseBoolParam(r *http.Request, name string) (*bool, error) {
	raw := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get(name))
	if raw == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	value, err := strconv.ParseBool(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid %s", name)
	}
	return &value, nil
}
